content: A clear note "Do not overtighten the screws" is missing, to prevent damaging the threads in the plastic spacers (the note is in the Core One + kit manual).

replies.content:
Update : replaced the spacers with new ones, and tightening them with 0,5 Nm torque does the job perfectly  (do so at your own risk of course ;)

Hope it helps others

Can confirm this is needed badly. I stripped out one of mine, and have the screw glued in until I can get a spare. IMO spares should be included in any upgrade or repair kit that requires removing the extruder assembly, or at least with the printer itself.
Agree - this warning would have been helpful for me.
Thanks for the feedback. You're right that this warning is important, especially since overtightening can damage the spacers. We'll add a clear warning.
